label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Lee,

Going halves on a dumper

I've written this down so you can look at the numbers properly instead of me going on at you in the van.

What hiring cost us this year

We had the tracked dumper from the Sittingbourne place for 14 days. At £85 a day plus £30 delivery each time, that came to roughly £1,600 all in.

That's only the money. In September they didn't have one, so we barrowed 6 ton of muck at Hernhill. It took 2 extra days and your back was gone for a week. Then there was the morning the driver turned up at 11 and we lost half of it stood about.

What's for sale

A bloke in Faversham has a 2019 500kg tracked one for £1,650 ono. He says it had new tracks fitted last spring. Halves is £825 each, less if we can knock him down a bit.

The sums

- This year's hire: about £1,600
- The dumper: £1,650, so £825 each
- At this year's use it pays for itself in about a year
- At half that use, about two years

That's before servicing and repairs, so I'm not pretending it costs nothing once we've bought it. But we've already got 3 patio digs and the Boughton drive booked in for spring, so it'd be earning from the off.

How we'd run it

- It lives in my lean-to at the yard, which is covered
- Servicing gets split 50/50
- Whoever breaks it pays for it

If it doesn't work out

We sell it on. They hold their value, so we wouldn't be stuck with it.

Saturday

Come and look at it with me this Saturday. If it's a dog we walk away and it's cost us nothing but the diesel to Faversham. I just want us to see it before someone else has it.
